## Document classification and checklist
documentTypeId: iep.amendment
resolution: classified
checklistPolicy: look_for_all_listed; never_invent_if_absent; extract_other_pack_records_if_found
unclassifiedPolicy: Unknown documents are read with the generic checklist, never forced into a type, and never counted toward requirements.
checklistRecordTypes (12 records, 70 fields): document_header, student, amendment_change, present_level, goal, short_term_objective, service, accommodation, placement, assessment_participation, transition, extended_school_year
### Global reading notes
Extract every record in this document type's checklist, including repeats. One table row or one goal is one record. Quote the source text that holds the record; every quoted field value must appear in that quote. Do not infer absent numbers, identities, relationships or legal conclusions. Report a labelled but empty field as field_present_but_empty, citing the label. Distinguish what is observed, planned and decided.

### Document-type reading notes
Record the date of the IEP being amended. Extract only the records the amendment changes or adds, plus one amendment_change per affected section.
### Document-scoped extraction targets
sourceDocumentId: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099

Emit recordInstances only for record types listed below; fieldIds must come from this catalog.
